name: NormCap
tagline: Capture text from any screen area
blurb: OCR-powered screen-capture tool to capture information instead of images.
description:
OCR-powered screen-capture tool to capture information instead of images.

Usage:

• Start NormCap

• Select a region on the screen

• Wait while the text is being extracted

• Paste the result from the clipboard (ctrl+v)

Features:

• Detects text in many different languages

• Detects QR codes and barcodes

• Heuristic parsing to improve results

• Works offline (data doesn't leave your computer)

• Supports multi-monitor setups

• Free and Open Source

• Available for Linux, Windows, and macOS

Tags: OCR, QR, barcode, screenshot, recognition, Tesseract

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
